source_contract.admission_rule: Use all six snapshots frozen in B_SOURCE_MANIFEST. No witness may be added, removed, replaced, or weighted using future information.

baseline_semantics.object: the complete configuration filesystem representing the cutoff migration result for the historical case
baseline_semantics.written_snapshot_rule: all JSON file blocks in the immutable snapshot are taken as the cutoff result
baseline_semantics.dry_run_rule: for a dry-run migration snapshot, use every explicit proposed '+' JSON output in the emitted per-file migration blocks; Biome snapshot middle-dot space rendering is deterministically reversed before strict JSON parsing
baseline_semantics.path_rule: relative configuration-file paths are semantic and preserved
baseline_semantics.json_rule: strict JSON parse; object-key order and insignificant whitespace are representation only; array order and scalar values are preserved
baseline_semantics.expected_path_rule: extracted path set must exactly match expected_paths or the witness construction is invalid

provenance_note: The first grounding draft incorrectly treated every snapshot as a single written biome.json. The nested snapshot is a three-file dry-run case. This manifest supersedes that extraction assumption before grounding adjudication and preserves the full nested-root semantics.
semantics: Each extracted filesystem is a frozen pre-future current-state witness on which the selected future Biome migration obligation will later be exercised externally.
